identitySignals: Official website livelifepoint.com says 'lifepoint' is a division of Carter-Kelly Consulting LLC, matching the agenda name 'Carter-Kelly Consulting/Lifepoint'
Website lists Oakland Tech High School among the places it has worked, matching the OUSD agreements for Oakland Technical High School
Services (family coaching, parenting and life-skills courses) are consistent with OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' category
Based in Oakland, CA per search listings, matching the agenda location
research.notes: Headquarters city taken from agenda text and search listings; no registry (CA SOS, SAM.gov) record was checked, so no entity number or UEI. General email not found on site (only a named person's address, deliberately omitted).

profile.summary: Carter-Kelly Consulting LLC runs lifepoint, a behavior learning resource center in the Oakland, California area. It offers family and life-skills coaching, parenting courses, workshops and consulting for individuals, families and organizations.

review.notes: livelifepoint.com states lifepoint is a division of Carter-Kelly Consulting LLC, lists Oakland Tech High School under 'Trusted By', and shows phone 510-463-1163; services fit OUSD's family-services category. Neither cited page states an Oakland location (only the 510 area code), so headquarters is unsupported by the sources (it rests on the agenda text); the summary's 'Oakland, California area' wording is only loosely supported.
